verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server includes a search tool that covers tasks, projects, goals, and other objects, but the evidence says it matches by name only. Nothing in the pack shows full-text search across task descriptions, docs, or comments. Nothing in the pack addresses search speed or accuracy either. missing for 10: full-text search over docs and comments, a native in-app search experience, evidence on result speed and relevance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results

citations.quote: Searches tasks, projects, project templates, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields, and AI Teammates by name.
Asana's official MCP server lets you interact with your Asana workspace through natural language—create tasks, search projects, analyze workload, and more—all from your preferred AI platform.
